about: Twin oracle of the push-down adapter calls one dispatch makes on a capable adapter (the kernel path, native and wasm hosts). Only the calls a push-down replaces are listed; frame reads differ per host and are not part of it. A plain persist is one writeBatch (hosts pass the kernel's WriteRows batch through as it is, G-ORB-352), a persist batch is one writeBatch, a fetch is one queryPage. emitFanoutPersistent: the benchmark's emit-fanout `go` over a persistent entity reads its frame row from the host once per dispatch (the kernel keeps a dispatch's answered reads; it asked 6 times before).
